title: Sorsogon market fire: Coastal road to host displaced vendors

blocks.text: SORSOGON CITY — The Sorsogon provincial government is preparing a portion of the coastal road as a temporary market for vendors displaced by a fire that gutted the Sorsogon City Public Market late Saturday, Oct. 24. Provincial administrator Eric Ravanilla said heavy equipment had been deployed to clear the site and make it accessible to vendors and customers. The provincial government plans to build temporary stalls within seven to 10 days and cement the ground to make the area more convenient for vendors and buyers, Ravanilla told the Inquirer in a phone interview.
